## About
VIP Tire & Automotive is a family-owned shop on S. La Brea Ave. in Los Angeles, run by Mark Husereau, who carries on the family business. When you visit, you'll be treated like a member of the family.
We handle new tires, custom wheels, complete brakes, front end work, fuel injection, electrical, air conditioning, oil changes and flat tire repair. From smogs to tire repairs, we'll be with you for the life of your vehicle.
Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 45 Google reviews. Stop by on a weekday or call ahead, and Mark will take a look.

## Services
- Auto repair: Repair and maintenance for your daily driver, from a check engine light to electrical and fuel injection work.
- New Tires: Tires for your car, fitted and mounted here at the shop.
- Wheels: Custom wheels to go with your new tires.
- Brakes and rotors: Brake work including rotors. One customer had her brakes and rotors replaced here.
- Tire Repairs: Losing air or picked up a nail? Bring it in and we'll take care of it.
- Smogs: Smog work for your car, along with everything else it needs over the years.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 1301 S. La Brea Ave., Unit B, in Los Angeles.

Q: Can I make an appointment?
A: Yes. Give us a call to set a time. One reviewer made an appointment for tires on his BMW and said we came through.

Q: How long has VIP been around?
A: We've been in business since 1968, and we'll be here for you.

Q: Do you work on older cars?
A: We do. Andrew L., a longtime customer, trusted us to help restore his car from 1974.
